The edits behind every scenario in a set, one row per op

Source: R/provenance.R
edit_log.Rd

Reads each scenario's @edits – the record build_scenario() keeps of exactly what it applied – and lays them out as a change log: one row per op, scenarios in lineage order (roots first, then each generation), ops in the order they were applied. Alongside each op it carries who proposed the scenario (@rationale$author) and why (@objective).

Usage

edit_log(set)

Arguments

set

A ScenarioSet.

Value

A data frame with one row per op:

scenario, parent

The scenario's label, and its parent's (its short id when the parent is not in the set).

author

@rationale$author: "human", "agent", "optimizer", or NA when unstated.

op

The operation, e.g. "transfer", or "allocation".

target

The rows the op acts on, as column value – "partner DSP A". For a transfer, its source; for add, the line item it creates; "(whole plan)" when the op names no target.

to

A transfer's destination; NA for every other op.

amount

The money the op states: the amount a transfer moves, a delta, an added line's spend, an allocation's net change. NA for ops that state no amount (scale, set, shift, ...).

detail

The op's own value, in words: "x1.2", "+7 days", "min 30,000".

window

The op's during window, or a transfer's per-side windows; NA when it has none.

objective

The scenario's @objective.

Details

An allocation edit (a data frame or named vector of absolute spend, typically an optimizer's output) is one row, op = "allocation", whose amount is the net change in the plan's total. A scenario with no recorded edits – a root, or a plan imported from a file – contributes no rows.

See also

build_scenario() for how edits and rationale are recorded; lineage() for the derivation tree itself.

Examples

base <- media_plan_from_df(
  data.frame(week = as.Date("2026-07-06"),
             channel = c("TV", "Search", "Social"),
             planned_spend = c(80, 40, 40)),
  grain = "channel", time = "week", name = "base"
)
s1 <- build_scenario(
  base, name = "Search push", objective = "Lift search share",
  edits = op_transfer(20, from = list(channel = "TV"),
                      to = list(channel = "Search")),
  rationale = list(author = "agent", goal = "maximise conversions")
)
s2 <- build_scenario(
  s1, name = "Trim social", objective = "Budget cut",
  edits = list(op_scale(0.5, target = list(channel = "Social")),
               op_delta(-5, target = list(channel = "TV"))),
  rationale = list(author = "human")
)
edit_log(add_scenario(add_scenario(scenario_set(base), s1), s2))
#>      scenario      parent author       op         target             to amount
#> 1 Search push        base  agent transfer     channel TV channel Search     20
#> 2 Trim social Search push  human    scale channel Social           <NA>     NA
#> 3 Trim social Search push  human    delta     channel TV           <NA>     -5
#>   detail window         objective
#> 1   <NA>   <NA> Lift search share
#> 2   x0.5   <NA>        Budget cut
#> 3   <NA>   <NA>        Budget cut
